question: A ray of light is incident on a concave mirror at point M. The ray makes an angle of 10° with a line joining M to the centre of curvature. The ray is reflected at an angle of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__10°__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• If a ray incident on the concave mirror passes through the center of the curvature, the reflected ray will** retrace its path.**

** ****CONCEPT:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14db7bc4c96d51900272afd08a3ba77bfa45d1e5fb5b198d406a9768f80c6bd7.png] 

__
 
• **i=r **
 
• For the spherical mirror, At a point where the incident ray falls, it follows the** law of reflection** i.e.,** the incident angle is equal to the reflected angle.**
 
• The normal line for this law of reflection is the line that passes through the center.
 
• When a ray **incident on a mirror at 90⁰ (On the normal line), it will reflect back at the same path.**

** ****EXPLANATION:**__

 
• The ray of light passes through the** center of curvature of a concave mirror**, it strikes the mirror along the normal ray It incidences on the mirror at an angle of 90⁰.
 
• Hence, the angle of incidence (i) = 10⁰.

 According to the** Law of Reflection,**

 Angle of reflection (r) = 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6731924a48099c8fd7da99b3ea652c0140b3c24f3afce210b66f9880b394f950.png] 

 
• Hence, **angle i = angle r.**
